classification.difficultyReason: The student directly applies the gradient formula to two explicitly supplied coordinates, then substitutes that gradient and the supplied intercept into y=mx+c. No fitting, graph estimation, contextual interpretation or unsignposted connection is required.

content.prompt:
This scatter plot shows a linear relationship between Geography marks and Economics marks in a small class of students. A trend line passes through $(10,41)$ and $(50,69)$.

Find the equation of the line if the $y$-intercept is $34$.

spec.description: Ungridded scatterplot with black crosses, 10-unit ticks, 20-unit numeric labels, italic subject-axis titles and a blue trend line with two labelled points.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal variable x is Geography percentage; vertical variable y is Economics percentage. Trend line y=0.7x+34 passes through (10,41) and (50,69); line extent x=8 to x=80. Crosses are chosen scatter positions near the line.
spec.answerVisibility: The trend line and its two coordinate labels are student-visible givens. The equation is answer-only.
